{{Top|leg}}
'''Droidification''' was a process by which a device or tool was given the ability to convert into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] form. The resultant droid generally had the limited cognitive capabilities of a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]], but its physical characteristics would be composed of elements of whatever device it was made of, and could vary widely in size.

The process was almost entirely applied to non-combat equipment, although the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]] matched the definition of a droidified vehicle, as did [[Phase III Dark Trooper|Phase III dark trooper]] of droidified armor.
